scope: Read-only audit of the observed CodeBuild successor. No cloud mutation, build submission, cancellation, worker action, protocol edit, or scientific execution was performed.

prior_review.status: preserved historical pre-discovery review; its manual-takeover proposal was not executed

invariants.only_observed_state_change: owner_build changed from original to successor after the original build became terminal

evidence: The project template sets AutoRetryLimit: 2 and grants its service role codebuild:RetryBuild.
The buildspec and run-controller wrapper contain no StartBuild or RetryBuild action.
The Rust controller submit route has the only package StartBuild call; it is an external submission ingress and was not invoked by the running controller.
The successor initiator is the CodeBuild service role for the original build, and autoRetryConfig links both builds.

aws_semantics.auto_retry_limit_2: two additional retries after the initial failed build, for at most three builds in the chain

protocol_interpretation.finding: The current successor is controller invocation 2 and remains inside the declared total-attempt cap. It is not a worker restore, second scientific payload, or new scientific submission. If it fails, the project may automatically create autoRetryNumber 2, which would be controller invocation 3 and would exceed the current frozen maximum-two-attempt wording.
protocol_interpretation.worker_restore_relation: Independent. Durable State.attempt equals State.restores and increments only on begin_restore; the observed successor claim left both at zero.
protocol_interpretation.single_submission_relation: The automatic retry reuses the exact request object and CodeBuild retry chain. It does not create another external recovery-submission receipt or new run identity.

deadlines.potential_auto_retry_2: If the successor fails, CodeBuild may start a third chain member with the same inherited 45-minute timeout. A start near 07:12Z would project to about 07:57Z, still before the immutable request deadline, but it is not admitted by the current maximum-two-attempt protocol.

prospective_amendment_review.condition: A new dated, independently reviewed and frozen protocol version must be committed before the third controller invocation it affects, while retaining both prior versions and all raw observations.

required_separation.controller_invocations: A new explicit operational cap may admit at most four same-request controller invocations.
required_separation.worker_scientific_attempts: Retain execution.retries.max_attempts = 2 because canonical history admission uses it as a total per-row scientific-attempt cap.
required_separation.scientific_payloads: Retain one active payload and prohibit a new run identity or automatic scientific retry.

immutable_fields: run name and durable ConfigMap state
current worker instance and Pod unless the already admitted single restore is required
source revision, binary and image digests
workload, arms, methods, seeds and execution order
prospective_amendment_review.fourth_controller_constraint: Only after controller invocation 3 is terminal and the durable run remains nonterminal; use the same request with autoRetryLimitOverride 0, bounded queue/time overrides and a distinct takeover receipt. No project update or IAM/RBAC change.
prospective_amendment_review.reason_not_to_reuse_execution_max_attemp: Changing execution.retries.max_attempts to four would silently broaden scientific record-attempt admission; native output_contract rejects histories above the existing value and the unknown-runtime gate lint pins the current value.

verdict: Current automatic successor is a same-request infrastructure controller retry and is admitted as the second total controller attempt. No manual takeover should run concurrently. A possible third automatic chain member is technically expected after another failure but is scientifically unadmitted unless the prospective operational amendment is reviewed, frozen and committed before that third invocation.
